about_the_game:
It’s shaping up to be a beautiful spring at Miskatonic University. Finishing your independent study is your only real concern. One night, you dream of a strange frozen wasteland full of monsters and ancient ruins, where a bizarre creature warns you of an ancient war that's in danger of reigniting. You wake up shaken, but not worried—until you realize that your classmates, too, seem a little less human than they did yesterday. To top it off, somebody’s ransacked the geology lab, ruining the project you need to ace to keep your scholarship, and stealing something irreplaceable—a deep core sample of very ancient Antarctic soil. Could this be the missing item that the creature in your dream told you to find?

Were the things you saw in the dream real? Was the quest you received more than the hallucination of a stressed sophomore? And what are you supposed to do with the knowledge that your best friend is some sort of fish-monster?

Starspawn: A Miskatonic Mystery has a game mode for everyone...

  • Explore a haunted Arkham and the strange dying world of the dreamlands

  • Travel through a retro pixel art landscape, mastering a variety of puzzles and arcade minigames

  • See the world through a first-person view, collecting and using items in point-and-click puzzles

  • Experience an epic visual novel that encompasses thousands of years of human history

  • Manage your time and sanity to get to know your friends and enemies better, and maybe even find love

  • Unlock nine potential endings based on your choices
